title: Lamar Jackson: Declan Doyle was dialing it up

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Lamar Jackson: Declan Doyle was dialing it up
sources.description: Quarterback Lamar Jackson said earlier this month that he does not "believe a defense is prepared for what’s in store for them" when facing a Ravens offense coordinated by Declan Doyle and it certainly didn't look like the Colts were prepared in Week 1.
